# fish completion for rtok
# Generated by Pyrlyn.CommandLine.Docs from the command model; do not edit.

set -g __rtok_paths 'completions' 'config' 'config get' 'config init' 'config path' 'config set' 'config show' 'config validate' 'hook' 'man' 'plugins'
set -g __rtok_values 'config get|--config' 'config init|--config' 'config path|--config' 'config set|--config' 'config show|--config' 'config validate|--config' 'hook|--host' 'man|--dir'

function __rtok_path
    set -l tokens (commandline -opc)
    set -e tokens[1]
    set -l cmd ''
    set -l skip 0
    for word in $tokens
        set -l next (string trim -- "$cmd $word")
        if test $skip = 1
            set skip 0
        else if string match -q -- '-*' $word
            contains -- "$cmd|$word" $__rtok_values; and set skip 1
        else if contains -- $next $__rtok_paths
            set cmd $next
        end
    end
    echo $cmd
end

function __rtok_at
    set -l at (__rtok_path)
    test "$at" = "$argv[1]"
end

complete -c rtok -f
complete -c rtok -n '__rtok_at ""' -a 'completions' -d 'Print or install shell completions (bash, zsh, fish, powershell; clink for Windows cmd).'
